newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zellweger to divest Burkhalter unit.
newsitem.headline: Zellweger to divest Burkhalter unit.

text.p: Zellweger Luwa AG said it would divest its Burkhalter division and concentrate on its high-tech core businesses of electronics, analytics and engineering.
"The board has decided as part of this new strategic orientation to divest the Burkhalter business," it said in a statement.
"From today's viewpoint a public share offer with participation of the management is in the forefront given Burkhalter's strong market position and earnings strength."
The installations and network technology division posted 1996 sales of 230.1 million Swiss francs and nearly doubled its operating profit to 12.9 million, it said.
